local p = {}
local data = mw.loadData('Module:Character/data')

local getArgs = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs
local yesno = require('Module:Yesno')
function p.main(frame)
	local args = getArgs(frame, {
		wrappers = 'Template:Character'
	})
	return p._main(args)
end
function p._main(args)
	local key = args[1]
	local chara = data[key]
	if not chara then
		mw.log('Character data missing:', key)
		return '&#32;<i>Character "'..key..'" not found</i>&#32;' -- no entry.
	end
	local name = chara.name
	local title = chara.title
	local pagename = chara.link or name
	local text = args[2] or title or name
	local grade = tonumber(chara.star)
	local attrs = {
		['data-name'] = name,
		['data-title'] = title,
		['data-star'] = tonumber(chara.star),
		['data-class'] = chara.class,
		['data-element'] = chara.element,
		['data-weapon'] = chara.weapon,
		['data-faction'] = chara.faction,
	}
	local icon = chara.iconImage or (name .. ' icon.png')
	local gridview = yesno(args.g or args.gv or args.gridview)
	local showname = yesno(args.sn or args.showname)
	local nobg = yesno(args.nobg)
	local root = mw.html.create('')
	if gridview then
		local wrapper = root:tag('div')
		:css{display='inline-block', position='relative', margin='5px'}
		local a = wrapper:tag('div')
		:addClass('a')
		local dtooltip = a:tag('div')
		:css{width='60px', height='auto', margin='auto'}
		:addClass('character-tooltip')
		:attr(attrs)
		:wikitext('[[File:'..icon..'|60x60px|center|link='..pagename..'|alt='..text..']]')
		if nobg == nil then
			if grade == 6 then
				dtooltip:css('background','linear-gradient(to top, rgba(255,200,0,1), rgba(255,200,0,0))')
			elseif grade == 5 then
				dtooltip:css('background','linear-gradient(to top, rgba(255,255,169,1), rgba(255,255,169,0))')
			elseif grade == 4 then
				dtooltip:css('background','linear-gradient(to top, rgba(214,197,214,1), rgba(214,197,214,0))')
			elseif grade == 3 then
				dtooltip:css('background','linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,170,238,1), rgba(0,170,238,0))')
			elseif grade == 2 then
				dtooltip:css('background','linear-gradient(to top, rgba(220,220,0,1), rgba(220,220,0,0))')
			elseif grade == 1 then
				dtooltip:css('background','linear-gradient(to top, rgba(160,160,160,1), rgba(160,160,160,0))')
			end
		end
		if nobg == nil then
			local line = dtooltip:tag('div')
			:css{height='3px', width='60px'}
			if grade == 6 then
				line:css('background-color','#FFC800')
			elseif grade == 5 then
				line:css('background-color','#FFFFA9')
			elseif grade == 4 then
				line:css('background-color','#D6C5D6')
			elseif grade == 3 then
				line:css('background-color','#00AAEE')
			elseif grade == 2 then
				line:css('background-color','#DCDC00')
			elseif grade == 1 then
				line:css('background','#A0A0A0')
			end
		end
		if showname then 
			local bottomname = a:tag('div')
			:css{['margin-top']='5px'}
			local ntooltip = bottomname:tag('span')
			:addClass('character-tooltip')
			:attr(attrs)
			:wikitext('[['..pagename..'|'..text..']]')
		end
		local border = args.border
		if border == 'limited' then
			wrapper:css('border', '1px solid #FF0000')
		elseif border == 'limited2' then
			wrapper:css('border', '1px solid #FF8000')
		elseif border == 'store' then
			wrapper:css('border', '1px solid #FFFF00')
		end
	else
		local stooltip = root:tag('span')
		:addClass('character-tooltip')
		:attr(attrs)
		:wikitext('[['..pagename..'|'..text..']]')
	end
	return root
end
return p
